findings: The RealWorld.fi / ActualSales block is the most conventional moment: two serif headings over small body text with hairline top-rules reads close to a feature-comparison pair, the only place the page flirts with template grammar.

what_works: Decisive asymmetric hero: oversized editorial serif with 'Macedo' indented to a second line, anchored against a burnt-amber long-exposure arc photograph on a navy sky — a composed type/space/image relationship, not a centered headline.

Genuine typographic point of view: high-contrast transitional/editorial serif set against a monospace utility voice carrying metadata ('§ 1 · boulevard du temple, paris, 1838', 'generation 253'), a pairing a default generator would not reach for.
Disciplined palette — cream and deep navy with a single warm amber accent sampled straight from the long-exposure plates — governed, restrained, no rainbow and no purple-blue gradient.

A coherent conceptual organism (Daguerre's plate → nine faces on one plate → analemma star-trail spiral) that threads bespoke diagrammatic graphics through alternating dark/light sections, far outside SaaS-landing shape.
A.reasoning: This is not template slop: the hero is a deliberate asymmetric system pairing an oversized indented serif name with a signature amber long-exposure photograph, and the whole page sustains a real serif/monospace typographic voice and a restrained cream-navy-amber harmony. The stranger test is satisfied within the first viewport — name, 'Co-founder of RealWorld.fi (asset-backed lending) and ActualSales (B2B lead generation)', and a visible me@andremacedo.com. Weak spots are confined to a mildly conventional two-column business block and a dense ghost-type panel, neither of which triggers a cardinal slop state; the editorial conviction and the Daguerre/analemma conceptual through-line clear the bar.

B.reasoning: This is a conceptually ambitious personal site executed in mostly generic, safe web design language. The photography and color are the strongest visible elements, but the typography lacks a modular scale or editorial conviction, the layout relies on default centering and section stacking, and the decorative long-exposure motifs are applied broadly without tight hierarchical control. It reads as high-end AI-generated portfolio art rather than a singular, risky living organism. Stranger test is passed immediately in the hero, but multiple slop states are present.
